name: AVD (DOXOrubicin / Vinblastine / Dacarbazine, bleomycin omitted)

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft decision-support protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Give antiemetic prophylaxis before each administration per the standard emetic-risk framework.

supportiveCare: AVD is the bleomycin-omitted backbone used after a negative interim PET to spare cumulative pulmonary toxicity.
Baseline LVEF before anthracycline; track cumulative doxorubicin exposure.
monitoring: CBC with differential before each administration
end-of-treatment FDG-PET (Deauville) to confirm complete metabolic response

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: AVD 'A'. DOXOrubicin 25 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Anthracycline cumulative cardiotoxicity warn 450 / hard 550 mg/m2. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Vinblastine
drugs.notes: AVD 'V'. Vinblastine 6 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. IV only. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).

drugs.name: Dacarbazine
drugs.notes: AVD 'D'. Dacarbazine 375 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 15 of a 28-day cycle. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).
